column1: # The controls behind the architecture rules.
# The gate `scripts/check-arch-rule-controls.py` derives the inventory from the
# test methods under shared/src/jvmTest/kotlin/com/singularity/todo/arch/, and
# fails when a derived rule has no row here. One row per rule:
#     rule_id <TAB> control_kind <TAB> control_ref <TAB> expects
# control_kind:
#   fixture   — a committed Kotlin source under shared/src/jvmTest/fixtures/.
#               `control_ref` is its path; `expects` is the shape the rule
#               hunts, as a substring the file must still contain — a fixture
#               that was "fixed" stops proving anything and fails the gate.
#   synthetic — a @Test method that runs the rule over a source built in the
#               test. `control_ref` is <TestClass>.<method>; the gate reads the
#               method and requires an assertion that a finding was produced.
#   none      — no control yet. `control_ref` names the document that records
#               the debt. These rows are counted against `# ceiling:` below,
#               which may only fall.
# ceiling: 14
ArchitectureTest.DAO mutations are ownership-scoped
ArchitectureTest.OutboxService must not own stateful logic
ArchitectureTest.SyncBootstrapper must not own event-handling logic
ArchitectureTest.SyncEngine child phases must not create their own StateFlow
ArchitectureTest.SyncEngine must not own business logic
ArchitectureTest.a preview uses the app theme, not a bare MaterialTheme
ArchitectureTest.colour literals live in theme files, not in feature code
ArchitectureTest.commonMain does not use JVM file APIs
ArchitectureTest.core layer reaches DAO mutations only through a repository
ArchitectureTest.feature use cases do not import repository implementations
ArchitectureTest.koog imports are confined to ai-related packages
ArchitectureTest.only the theme itself reads isSystemInDarkTheme
ArchitectureTest.repository implementations are imported only from di modules
ArchitectureTest.repository interfaces declare no Blocking methods
ArchitectureTest.repository read methods are user-scoped
ArchitectureTest.the question asked of the index is built by the rule
DiFacadeTest.per-domain DiModule files declare no loose bindings
SingleOfKotlinDefaultsTest.allowlistedClassesHaveNoDefaults
